Netpay Configuration: Pre-authorization (NetPay Check-in/Check-out): checkout only holds the amount; the charge happens when the invoice is created with "Capture Online" (quantities can be adjusted; NetPay accepts a final amount within 20% of the held one). The hold expires after 5 business days (Visa/MC). Requires Check-in/Check-out enabled on the NetPay account. Installments (MSI) are disabled while pre-authorization is active.
Configuración de NetPay: Preautorización (Check-in/Check-out de NetPay): el checkout solo retiene el monto; el cobro ocurre al crear la factura con "Capture Online" (se pueden ajustar las cantidades; NetPay acepta un monto final dentro del 20% del retenido). La retención expira a los 5 días hábiles (Visa/MC). Requiere que la cuenta NetPay tenga habilitado Check-in/Check-out. Los meses sin intereses (MSI) se deshabilitan con la preautorización activa.

Netpay Configuration: To charge the real amount: Invoice -> adjust quantities (0 for missing items) -> Amount: "Capture Online" -> Submit Invoice. NetPay allows capturing within 20% above or below the held amount. The hold expires ~5 business days after it was created (Visa/MC; Amex 7). Cancelling the order releases the hold.

NetPay permite capturar hasta un 20% arriba o abajo del monto retenido. La retención vence ~5 días hábiles después de creada (Visa/MC; Amex 7). Cancelar el pedido libera la retención.
